decision_basis: Representative speed benefit is not balanced: 4L FG improves; H is about 1% slower in matched pristine pairs; 1L–3L guarded-request ranges overlap.
5L cold root and batch ratios of arm medians are +2.63% and +7.76% versus pristine; medians of matched ratios are +2.13% and +3.98%. All 5L arm timing ranges overlap.
5L warm-batch improvement relative to pristine is shared by the map control; it does not establish an LC-specific benefit.
Modest 4L whole-process RSS savings do not establish the requested conditional speed criterion.
This decision applies to checked point updates with timed map publication boundaries, not every LC representation or bulk-merge design.
